scenario: Exposure of customer & driver PII held unmasked in non-production
asset: Restricted PII (driver identity, location), Confidential customer PII
threat: Compromise of a lower-trust staging environment; insider access
vulnerability: Production PII copied into staging without masking; no non-prod data controls

scenario: Unauthorized production change via standing privileged access
threat: Malicious or mistaken use of privileged credentials
vulnerability: Standing admin for 6 accounts; no just-in-time elevation or session logging

scenario: Exploitation of an unpatched known vulnerability
threat: External attacker exploiting a known/listed (KEV) vulnerability
vulnerability: Remediation SLA missed for ~35% of findings; no single aged backlog

scenario: Prolonged outage or data loss from an unvalidated DR capability
threat: Regional AWS failure, data corruption, or ransomware
vulnerability: RTO/RPO never validated by full failover; BCP unratified

scenario: Workforce account takeover via phishing
asset: SSO identities, corporate and cloud access
threat: Credential phishing / social engineering
vulnerability: Role-based training & phishing simulations not run on a regular cadence

scenario: Insider misuse enabled by inadequate access reviews
asset: Customer data, source code, production systems
threat: Malicious insider or accumulated excess privilege
vulnerability: Access recertification irregular; residual segregation-of-duties conflicts

scenario: Sensitive-data exfiltration through unmonitored egress
threat: Insider or compromised account exfiltrating data
vulnerability: No DLP coverage on email, SaaS, or endpoints

scenario: Software supply-chain compromise via third-party dependencies
threat: Malicious or vulnerable upstream dependency / build tampering
vulnerability: No standardized SBOM; artifact provenance not verified for all components

scenario: Cloud misconfiguration exposing data or services
asset: AWS resources (S3, RDS, IAM, security groups)
threat: Attacker discovering a misconfigured / drifted resource
vulnerability: Configuration drift not continuously detected across all accounts

scenario: Cross-tenant data access (tenant isolation failure)
threat: Application flaw breaking logical tenant boundaries
vulnerability: Application-layer monitoring for isolation anomalies incomplete

scenario: Breach at a supplier or sub-processor
asset: Data shared with Okta, Stripe, MDR, SIEM, Google Workspace
threat: Compromise of a critical supplier processing Sightline data
vulnerability: Annual supplier re-review inconsistent; SOC 2 reports not fully collected

scenario: Non-compliance with GDPR / CCPA obligations
asset: Personal data of EU and California data subjects
threat: Regulatory action or data-subject complaint
vulnerability: Classification/labelling incomplete; tenant-deletion partly manual

scenario: Ransomware or malware impacting operations
threat: Ransomware via phishing, compromised dependency, or exposed service
vulnerability: Residual gaps in patching and application-layer detection

scenario: Loss or theft of a workforce device
threat: Device lost, stolen, or left unattended
vulnerability: Off-premises asset register incomplete; no device location/lost-mode

scenario: Undetected security incident at the application layer
threat: Business-logic abuse or authorization anomaly going unnoticed
vulnerability: SIEM alerting tuned mainly to infra/endpoint; app-layer coverage gaps

scenario: Leakage of secrets or credentials in code / CI
asset: API keys, database credentials, KMS keys
threat: Accidental commit or exposure of a secret
vulnerability: Residual reliance on scanning; secret-handling not fully hardened in CI

scenario: Release of insecure software to production
threat: Vulnerability shipped due to missing security gate
vulnerability: No ratified secure-SDLC; SAST advisory-only; no release security gate

scenario: Loss of evidential integrity during an incident
threat: Inability to preserve defensible evidence after an incident
vulnerability: No forensic evidence-collection / chain-of-custody procedure

scenario: Failure to meet breach-notification timelines
threat: Late or missed notification to regulators/customers after a breach
vulnerability: IR plan strong, but evidence handling and authority contacts under-exercised

scenario: Key-person dependency / duties concentration
threat: Loss or unavailability of a key individual
vulnerability: Small team; residual segregation-of-duties conflicts; documentation gaps
